D3DDevice_SetPalette.evidence: Evolution map editor: stdcall (stage, palette), ret 8, 141 bytes; writes CDevice Palettes + stage * 4 (0xF98) with the AddRef/Release pair and pushes the stage's palette methods. The 5849 signature misses it. The same body as Instincts' 005070E0.

D3DDevice_SetRenderTargetFast.evidence: Evolution's editor: stdcall (render target, depth stencil, flags), ret 12, 288 bytes; like SetRenderTarget (0x00517140) it AddRefs the new surfaces, Releases the old and writes CDevice RenderTarget (0x1A04) and Depth (0x1A08), then pushes the surface methods (0x40210 colour, 0x40214 zeta, 0x4030C/0x4032C), without the viewport reset; 3 callers. The 5849 signatures miss it.
